title: tabernaemontana tessmannii
intro: Tabernaemontana tessmannii, commonly known as the African yellow wood, is a plant species native to tropical Africa. The health benefits of Tabernaemontana tessmannii include its potential anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antimalarial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, pain, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids like voacangine and voacristine, that exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antitumor activities. These bioactive compounds contribute to the plant's therapeutic properties and have been studied for their potential to treat various health conditions.
